text: Theme Asuka // 02 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的外观主题插件。它接入 DSH Host 设置与 Web 客户端，在设置中提供快速场景切换和完整主题面板。用户可选择明日香风格的晨间、午间或东京-3 夜景，调整壁纸启用状态、时段、透明度与模糊度，并设置装饰细节和减少动态效果；主题同时调整界面配色与玻璃质感，并支持关闭后恢复原外观。适合希望为 DSH Web 更换视觉风格并按时间或偏好配置壁纸的用户。README 给出 DSH 插件安装方式；代码未读取 API 密钥或调用外部服务。

Theme Asuka // 02 adds Asuka-inspired colors and time-based wallpapers to DSH Web. Choose morning, noon, or Tokyo-3 night scenes, then adjust wallpaper timing, opacity, blur, details, and motion in Settings. The client adds glass styling and restores the prior appearance when disabled.
想给 DSH Web 换成明日香风格的主题。
能不能让 DSH 的壁纸按早晨、中午和夜晚切换？
I want to customize the DSH Web theme and wallpaper appearance.
Theme Asuka // 02 的功能「主题与场景切换」：在 DSH Settings 的快速行或主题设置页选择关闭、晨间、午间或夜景主题；自动时段按本地时间确定配色和壁纸场景。
Theme Asuka // 02 的功能「壁纸与外观调节」：在主题设置中启用壁纸并设置时段、透明度、模糊、装饰细节和减少动态效果；界面同步显示主题外观。

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · Theme Asuka // 02：[简体中文](README-zh-CN.md)

An unofficial fan-made Light/Dark appearance plugin for the DeepSeek Harness
Web UI. It pairs restrained school blue, ribbon red, warm paper, and quiet
Tokyo-3 night tones with three right-composed wallpapers that follow the local
time of day.

> Not affiliated with DeepSeek, khara, Evangelion, or any original rights
> holder.

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · Compatibility：- DSH: `0.2.1-rc.2`
- Cordis: `4.0.5`
- Node.js: `>=20`
- Target: Ubuntu / WSL2 Ubuntu with DSH Web and Linux Chrome

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · Compatibility：Version `3.3.0` targets DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` and includes WebGPU optics. Its glass
surfaces, scene switching and sidebar/menu behavior were checked in an isolated
Windows DSH Web profile using the Codex in-app browser. Ubuntu/WSL and real model
streaming have not been rechecked for this baseline; the user's 2026-10-01 WSL
confirmation belongs to `3.2.2` / DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. See
[COMPATIBILITY.md](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) for evidence and limits.

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · npm (recommended)：Install the [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-asuka-school-theme) using either the DSH plugin installation page or the command line. Both methods install prebuilt Host/Client code and all three public wallpapers.

**DSH plugin installation page:** open the plugin installation page, enter the npm package name below, and install:

```text
dsh-asuka-school-theme
```

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · npm (recommended)：The package name installs the latest version. To install this specific release, enter `dsh-asuka-school-theme@3.3.0` instead.

**Command line:** run on the host where DSH is installed (PowerShell or a Unix shell):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-asuka-school-theme@3.3.0
```

Restart the DSH Web profile after installing, updating or removing the plugin.

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · GitHub Release (alternative)：Install the prebuilt `3.3.0` Release asset:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Yyyyyylor/dsh-asuka-school-theme/releases/download/v3.3.0/dsh-asuka-school-theme-3.3.0.tgz
```

The Release asset contains the same prebuilt Host/Client code and all three public wallpapers.

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · From a local checkout：In the repository root, run:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-asuka-school-theme-3.3.0.tgz

The package filename should match the `.tgz` emitted by `npm pack`.

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · GitHub source tag (alternative)：Install from the fixed `v3.3.0` source tag:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Yyyyyylor/dsh-asuka-school-theme#v3.3.0
```

This requires Git to be available on the host. Pin the tag instead of using
`main` so updates remain predictable.

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · Use：Version 3.3.0 uses WebGPU to render rounded lens refraction maps,
Fresnel/specular light and a restrained caustic rim. SVG backdrop filters then
sample the live page behind each surface, including DOM text; no wallpaper
copy, screen recording or DOM rasterization library is used. The GPU canvas
contains optical data, not the page image. Maps update on geometry changes,
not in a continuous frame loop. Missing WebGPU, device loss or initialization
failure retains the existing SVG optics; unsupported backdrop engines retain
frosted glass. WebGPU requires a secure context (HTTPS or localhost).

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · Use：Rounded background refraction applies to the composer,
sidebar, header, menus and Settings on Chromium, with a curved highlight rim
and subtle dispersion on compact controls. Settings uses a stronger 48px
background blur while keeping its translucent tint and rim highlights.
Other engines retain frosted glass.
On narrow windows, the right sidebar shares the available width with the main
content instead of automatically covering it; its fullscreen button remains available.
Its button glyph, tooltip and keyboard shortcut follow the displayed layout;
exiting fullscreen returns to the shared width while keeping the sidebar open.
Fullscreen entry and exit animate the sidebar and main area together, with one
glass rim and stable conversation content during the transition.
Pointer highlights respond softly near the rim and fade when the pointer leaves.
Both reduced-motion preferences stop pointer-following highlights. This is a
Web effect inspired by Liquid Glass; it does not use Apple's native material.
See [the implementation and verification limits](docs/LIQUID-GLASS.md).

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · Use：- Open **Settings → General → Theme-Asuka** for the quick Off / On the Way to
  School / Noon Classroom / Tokyo-3 Night scene switch.
- Open **Settings → Theme-Asuka** for wallpaper period, opacity, blur,
  decorative details, reduced motion, and reset. In the default automatic
  setting, Early is 06:00–11:00, Noon is 11:00–17:00, and Night is 17:00–06:00;
  the wallpaper crossfades at each boundary.
- New-session and active-conversation composer cards share the same lighter,
  scene-aware liquid-glass surface, keeping more of the wallpaper visible.
- Assistant replies, reasoning, tool calls/output and errors share the message
  glass material and remain readable above 100% wallpaper opacity.
- Presented file cards and model submenus use matching rounded glass; file
  actions retain one shared frame and their native preview/menu behavior.
- The composer's add menu keeps its rounded frosted glass and blurs content behind
  it; clicking either the add button or workspace selector again closes its menu.
  The add menu retains its bottom scroll hint separately from the glass rim. Split dividers stop
  inside the rounded edges.

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · Use：The default mode is **Off**. This plugin leaves the official Light, Dark, and
System appearance unchanged; it only adds the selected wallpaper scene.

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · Use：Wallpaper images are decoded before the existing crossfade starts, and likely
next scenes are preloaded while the browser is idle. Range-control previews are
frame-coalesced, so opacity and blur adjustments remain responsive without
reapplying unrelated theme tokens. Previously decoded preset images are reused
until plugin disposal; blur is applied to each wallpaper layer before its opacity
crossfade, avoiding a filtered parent that flattens both changing layers.
Palette variables are prepared off-document and applied in one style update.

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · Privacy and assets：No credentials, telemetry, image upload, or browser `localStorage` preference
store is used. Scalar preferences are stored in DSH's plugin-owned Host
entry's live Config form (`asuka-school-theme`). DSH migrates the old settings
document into the profile; the entry ID and preference fields are unchanged.
The three bundled WebPs are generated project assets; see
[assets/LICENSE.md](assets/LICENSE.md) and [docs/ASSETS.md](docs/ASSETS.md).

Do not package private artwork from `assets/private/`.

dsh-asuka-school-theme README · Privacy and assets：The Host reads only the three package-owned images and serves fixed GET/HEAD
routes on the existing DSH Web server. The browser uses same-origin DSH
transport for images, settings and explicit session-title edits. No third-party
service, data upload, telemetry, credentials or subprocess is used. The runtime
dependency is pinned Schemastery `3.18.5`; DSH/Cordis are host-provided optional
peers, not additional runtime installations. There are no installation lifecycle
scripts. See [Store review](STORE-REVIEW.md) for dependency, permission and
failure boundaries. Independent supply-chain review and Store automatic
rechecking remain pending; declarations do not guarantee approval.
